title: NA60021: Physical And Dynamical Oceanography
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to Worlds oceans - Temperature, salinity and density â equation
of state â Oceans heat budget. Fluid motion in a rotating system - basic
equations - analytical descriptions applied to oceanic fluid motion - force
balance in oceanography. Dynamic processes and general circulation - various
mathematical models for ocean circulation - dynamics of upper ocean surface waves, tides and sea level - generation of waves by wind - various theories internal waves - wind driven and thermohaline circulation - oceanic boundary
layers - near shore circulation â diffusion and turbulence - effect of bottom
topography and lateral boundaries.
